title.en: NVIDIA Enters $105B Credit Support Agreement for OpenAI Ohio PORTS-Pike Campus
title.zhHans: NVIDIA 就 OpenAI 俄亥俄 PORTS-Pike 智算中心达成最高 1050 亿美元信用担保协议

searchSummary.en: NVIDIA entered an agreement capping residual value guarantees at $105 billion for OpenAI’s initial 4.25-GW data center deployment in Ohio.
searchSummary.zhHans: NVIDIA 签署协议，为 OpenAI 在俄亥俄州首期 4.25GW 智算中心部署提供累计上限 1050 亿美元的剩余价值担保。

summary.en: On August 17, 2026, NVIDIA disclosed in an SEC filing that it entered into residual value guaranties with SB Energy capping aggregate payment obligations at $105 billion to support the initial 4.25-GW IT load phase of the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Ohio, where OpenAI will be the tenant. Reports on August 14 had noted preliminary guarantee discussions had been downsized from earlier $250 billion estimates.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 17 日，NVIDIA 在 SEC 文件中披露已与 SB Energy 达成剩余价值担保协议，将其在俄亥俄州 PORTS-Pike 园区首期约 4.25GW IT 负载建设中的累计担保付款上限设定为 1050 亿美元，OpenAI 为承租方。此前 8 月 14 日的媒体报道显示，初步担保规模已从早先讨论的 2500 亿美元缩减。

narrative.en: NVIDIA filed a Form 8-K disclosing that it entered multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy to secure land, power, and shell capacity at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio. An OpenAI affiliate will be the tenant utilizing 4.25 gigawatts of IT load exclusively hosting NVIDIA DSX platforms, with commercial service expected to begin in 2028. NVIDIA’s payment obligation is capped at $105 billion and triggered only upon OpenAI insolvency or lease default, after which NVIDIA can relet, assume, or terminate leases. NVIDIA holds an option for an additional 3.75 GW. The contractual cap resolved weeks of market debate regarding circular financing and unconstrained vendor exposure.
narrative.zhHans: NVIDIA 向 SEC 提交 8-K 文件，披露已与 SB Energy 签署多项剩余价值担保协议，以锁定俄亥俄州派克县 PORTS-Pike 园区的土地、电力与建筑外壳容量。OpenAI 关联公司将作为租户使用 4.25GW IT 负载并独家部署 NVIDIA DSX 平台，预计于 2028 年起分阶段投运。NVIDIA 的累计付款义务上限为 1050 亿美元，仅在 OpenAI 破产或租约违约时触发，NVIDIA 可选择转租、承接或终止租约。NVIDIA 另享有额外 3.75GW 容量的担保期权。这一确定性合同上限平息了市场此前对循环融资与无上限供应商风险的担忧。

description.en: Establishes a legally binding $105B credit-support framework for multi-gigawatt sovereign AI infrastructure, structuring risk between chip suppliers, developers, and model labs.
description.zhHans: 为多吉瓦级 AI 智算基础设施确立了具有法律约束力的 1050 亿美元信用担保框架，明确了芯片供应商、开发商与模型实验室之间的风险分担机制。

text.en: On August 17, 2026, NVIDIA disclosed in Form 8-K that its aggregate payment obligations under residual value guaranties for the initial 4.25-GW PORTS-Pike phase are cumulatively capped at $105 billion.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 17 日，NVIDIA 在 8-K 文件中披露，其在 PORTS-Pike 园区首期 4.25GW 剩余价值担保下的累计付款义务上限为 1050 亿美元。

text.en: The formal agreement replaced earlier reported $250B backstop discussions with a capped $105B contingent guarantee structure.
text.zhHans: 正式协议以 1050 亿美元有上限的或有担保结构取代了此前媒体报道的 2500 亿美元兜底讨论。

text.en: Payment obligations are conditional upon lessor ready-for-service milestones expected beginning in 2028, and optional 3.75-GW capacity remains discretionary.
text.zhHans: 付款义务以出租方预计自 2028 年起满足的可投运里程碑为前提，且额外的 3.75GW 扩容支持属于可自由裁量的期权。

editorial.reviewNotes: Published after Tier-1 news report corroboration of infrastructure financing adjustments. Reviewed 2026-08-24 after the latest-30 evidence, calibration, and language audit.
